name: German Rechnung
description: German invoice (Rechnung). Detects USt-IdNr (VAT ID), Steuernummer, IBAN, BIC/SWIFT (context-anchored), German dates, German phone numbers, German street addresses and PLZ + city, plus names and emails. Amounts kept visible so line items stay readable — toggle 'Amounts' manually to hide totals too.

patterns.name: Steuernummer
patterns.description: German tax number, matched with its label (Steuernummer, Steuer-Nr., St.-Nr.); the format varies by Bundesland.

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups.

patterns.name: BIC / SWIFT
patterns.description: Bank identifier code, 8 or 11 characters, matched with its BIC or SWIFT label.

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: German phone number, landline or mobile, optional +49, not inside longer numbers.
